Democrats and Republicans came together to pass the ROAD to Housing Act because it's based on what works: cutting red tape, rewarding results, lowering costs.

As Governor, I’ll build on it, speeding up permitting, using surplus state land and vacant buildings, and working with the private sector to build more homes. Because lowering costs starts with more housing.

posts.text:
Northern Minnesota’s small businesses are facing an incredibly difficult season. The Boundary Waters are one of Minnesota’s greatest treasures — and the outfitters, restaurants, hotels, and shops that depend on them need real support.

As Minnesota’s governor, I would do everything to help communities hit by disasters and, in the long haul, expand tourism across Minnesota, cut red tape, and open new markets for businesses.
